select id, type,sub_type,duration ,action,user_name, service_name,server_ip,env,remote_ip,request_url, request_type,create_time from bedrock_log_operation blo
and blo.create_time >= #{param.startTime}
and blo.create_time <= #{param.endTime}
and blo.type like concat('%',#{param.type},'%')
and blo.sub_type like concat('%',#{param.subType},'%')
and blo.user_name like concat('%',#{param.userName},'%')
and blo.service_name like concat('%',#{param.serviceName},'%')
and blo.server_ip like concat('%',#{param.serverIp},'%')
and blo.remote_ip like concat('%',#{param.remoteIp},'%')
and blo.request_url like concat('%',#{param.requestUrl},'%')
and blo.request_type = #{param.requestType}
order by blo.create_time desc
